summary: A booklet of step-by-step scenarios for trying out ARPANET host computers. Using annotated scripts from the MIT-DMCG PDP-10 system, it shows logging in, using simple features, getting online help and chatting with other users, to help newcomers and system programmers.

eli5.summary: A how-to with sample sessions for first-time users. It shows what to type and what the computer says back.
